:::{#def-linear-decay}
#### Linear decay

Let $s^{(0)}, s^{(\schedlen)} > 0$ be a starting and a final [step length](#def-gradient-descent),
and let $\schedlen$ be a number of updates. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
The **linear decay** schedule is

$$
s^{(t)} \eqdef \paren{1 - \schedfrac}\,s^{(0)} + \schedfrac\,s^{(\schedlen)},
\qquad
\schedfrac \eqdef \minf{\frac{t}{\schedlen}, 1}.
$$

:::
